# First Part

## The Garden

[1845 1]

[GDN 0001] The gardener rises before the sun and walks the narrow rows, counting each seed that the birds have left behind.*)

[Note *)] The counting is a habit, not a rule of the garden.

[GDN 0002] A wall of old stone keeps the wind from the beds, and moss grows in [1845 2] every crack of it.

## The Well

[GDN 0003] Water comes from a deep well whose rope is older than the house, and the bucket rises slowly.**)

[Note **)] The rope was replaced once, in a dry summer.

[1845 3]

[GDN 0004] At noon the gardener rests in the shade and listens to the bees moving among the bean flowers.

[GDN 0005] Evening brings a cool wind from the hills.
